summary: This bill grants the Secretary of Homeland Security explicit authority to issue work permits to individuals who receive deferred action under the DACA policy, including new applicants, overriding any judicial decisions that restrict such authorization.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly grants statutory authority for the Secretary of Homeland Security to issue Employment Authorization Documents to individuals under the DACA policy, including new applicants. This expands work authorization for undocumented immigrants, which aligns with 'more immigration' rather than 'secure borders'. The entire bill is dedicated to this purpose.
